amazighbands.basis: A judgement, not a count, made before collecting. Cassette-era catalogue of the Sous: Izenzaren (two bands after the 1975 split) issued EPs from 1976 and cassettes through the 1980s; Oudaden alone are credited with about thirty to thirty-eight albums; Archach, Ali Chouhad, Ammouri M'barek and dozens of wedding bands (tagroupit) put out cassettes on Sous labels; streaming services now carry hundreds of digitised singles. An insider's essential list would be about 40: Ousmane's singles and Olympia recording, the 1970s Izenzaren EPs, early Archach and Oudaden, and a few later bands.
